import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] s1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] s2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}};
    static int[][][] idx = new int[65][15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static int id_counter = 1;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int src, dst;
        long capacity, flow;

        FlowEdge() {
            src = 0; dst = 0; capacity = 0; flow = 0;
        }

        FlowEdge(int s, int d, long cap) {
            src = s; dst = d; capacity = cap; flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class DinicMaxFlow {
        int vertexCount;
        List<FlowEdge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] level, ptr;

        DinicMaxFlow(int n) {
            vertexCount = n;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u != v) {
                edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, cap));
                adj.get(u).add(edges.size() - 1);
                edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, 0));
                adj.get(v).add(edges.size() - 1);
            }
        }

        boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            Arrays.fill(level, vertexCount + 1);
            level[source] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == sink) break;
                for (int idx_edge : adj.get(u)) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges.get(idx_edge);
                    if (e.flow < e.capacity && level[e.dst] > level[e.src] + 1) {
                        level[e.dst] = level[e.src] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] <= vertexCount;
        }

        long dfs(int u, int sink, long bottleneck) {
            if (u == sink || bottleneck == 0) return bottleneck;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                FlowEdge e = edges.get(adj.get(u).get(i));
                FlowEdge rev = edges.get(adj.get(u).get(i) ^ 1);
                if (level[e.dst] == level[e.src] + 1) {
                    long available = e.capacity - e.flow;
                    if (bottleneck != -1 && available > bottleneck) available = bottleneck;
                    long pushed = dfs(e.dst, sink, available);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        rev.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long getMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(source, sink)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(source, sink, -1);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int layer = 0; layer <= t + 1; layer++) {
            for (int row = 1; row <= n; row++) {
                for (int col = 1; col <= n; col++) {
                    idx[layer][row][col] = id_counter++;
                }
            }
        }
        id_counter++;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        Queue<int[]> bfsQ = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfsQ.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!bfsQ.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfsQ.poll();
            int uy = cell[0], ux = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int vy = uy + dir[d][0], vx = ux + dir[d][1];
                if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && dist[vy][vx] == -1) {
                    dist[vy][vx] = dist[uy][ux] + 1;
                    bfsQ.offer(new int[]{vy, vx});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
                if (dist[i][j] > t) dist[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
            }
        }
        
        int sourceNode = 0, sinkNode = id_counter - 1;
        DinicMaxFlow flowSolver = new DinicMaxFlow(id_counter);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] >= '1' && s1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    flowSolver.addEdge(sourceNode, idx[0][i][j], s1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int vy = i + dir[k][0], vx = j + dir[k][1];
                    if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && s1[vy][vx] != 'Z') {
                        for (int x = 0; x < t; x++) {
                            if (dist[vy][vx] >= x + 1 && dist[i][j] > x) {
                                flowSolver.addEdge(idx[x][i][j], idx[x + 1][vy][vx], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int x = 0; x <= t; x++) {
                    if (s2[i][j] >= '1' && s2[i][j] <= '9') {
                        flowSolver.addEdge(idx[x][i][j], idx[t + 1][i][j], s2[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (s2[i][j] >= '1' && s2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    flowSolver.addEdge(idx[t + 1][i][j], sinkNode, s2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println((int) flowSolver.getMaxFlow(sourceNode, sinkNode));
    }
}
